_comment: Production resource-pack budget + validation limits (SÜLD). Raw source meshes (GLB/FBX/OBJ) are FORBIDDEN in resourcepack/ — they live in assets/source/. Textures: 32/64/128 for ordinary items, 256 for hero items (listed), higher only with justification in `justified_large`.

justified_large.resourcepack/assets/suld/textures/font/g: GUI background drawn into the container title (font glyph): must be exactly 176 px wide, the width of a chest screen

justified_prefixes.resourcepack/assets/suld/textures/font/h: HUD glyphs (gen_hud.py): bar fills are 896/2048 px wide because one glyph is one bar length; frames and target plaques are drawn at 2x
justified_prefixes.resourcepack/assets/suld/textures/font/b: name-tag/TAB badges from the owner's HD sheet (hd_art.SCALE = 4x the 9 px glyph), so they stay sharp at GUI scale 4
justified_prefixes.resourcepack/assets/suld/textures/font/g: chest-screen backgrounds drawn into the container title: exactly 176 GUI px wide (4x HD art from the owner's painting in gui/tiles/: tools/pack/glyph_tiles.py cuts every glyph over the client's 256-texel limit into tiles)
justified_prefixes.resourcepack/assets/suld/textures/gui/sp: the suld:mongol tooltip nine-slice from the owner's painting, 4x HD
justified_prefixes.resourcepack/assets/suld/textures/entity: the full-screen skill tree backdrop (display entity), one 512x288 panel
justified_prefixes.resourcepack/assets/minecraft/textures/g: the survival inventory (E) from the owner's mock-up: the vanilla 256 px sheet at 4x (1024 px), sharp at GUI scale 4

blank sprites hiding vanilla HUD/boss bars (gen_hud.blank_sprites), the inventory's slot placeholders and recipe button at 4x (gen_ui.gui_inventory), the default tooltip frame, widget buttons and slot highlight at 4x (gen_ui.tooltip_style, hub_kit)
justified_prefixes.resourcepack/assets/minecraft/textures/e: the training grounds' HD Warden (tools/pack/hd_warden.py): the vanilla 128 px Warden sheets at 4x (512 px) with a voxel bevel, as the owner's HD reference
justified_prefixes.resourcepack/assets/suld/textures/entity: «Сүлдийн Атлас» (tools/map/atlas_art.py pack): the frame in front of the map wall and the parchment behind it, drawn at 128 px a block like the maps themselves (sizes multiples of 16 for the block atlas's mipmaps)

_duplicates_allowed_under_comment: blank sprites that hide vanilla HUD elements (gen_hud.blank_sprites) are identical by design; the suld:mongol tooltip sprites equal the pack's default tooltip sprites on purpose (one frame for every tooltip)

justified_large_files.resourcepack/assets/suld/models/prop/dee: Meshy prop voxelised to a box model (tools/meshy); 48 KB zipped
justified_large_files.resourcepack/assets/suld/models/prop/sil: Meshy prop voxelised to a box model (tools/meshy); 43 KB zipped
justified_large_files.resourcepack/assets/suld/models/prop/sto: Meshy prop voxelised to a box model (tools/meshy); 37 KB zipped
justified_large_files.resourcepack/assets/minecraft/textures/g: the HD survival inventory (owner's mock-up, 4x); a painted texture, PNG cannot shrink it further without losing the art
